issues.title: Experimental beer comparison can be confusing
issues.description: The experimental comparison may present values that are easy to interpret as day counts or strong conclusions when the sample is small.
issues.workaround: Treat CHB Intelligence as experimental and verify the sample-size labels.
issues.plannedResolution: Dedicated CHB Intelligence quality pass with clearer units, minimum sample sizes and confidence indicators.

issues.title: Production main chunk exceeds the Vite warning threshold
issues.description: The production bundle currently emits a chunk-size warning after minification.
issues.workaround: The warning does not block deployment.
issues.plannedResolution: Add route-level lazy loading and production code splitting during a later quality pass.

issues.title: Historical sessions do not contain exact source clock times
issues.description: The source screenshots contain daily duration but not exact session start and end times.
issues.workaround: Use duration-placeholder session IDs and exclude those sessions from future hour-of-day analysis.
issues.plannedResolution: Keep the imported duration for totals. Exact clock-time analysis will use only native CHB sessions unless original timestamps are provided later.

issues.title: Legacy cloud snapshot lacks Portfolio arrays
issues.description: Snapshots created before v0.6.0 do not contain portfolioAccounts, portfolioTags or portfolioTransactions.
issues.workaround: Install v0.6.0a and preserve the local version when resolving the first post-upgrade comparison.

issues.title: Portfolio CSV import result was discarded by the hook
issues.description: The generic action wrapper returned Promise<void>, while the CSV panel required the import summary.
